metadata.datasource: Fotufilm runtime film profile by MUAStudio Inc.; released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sampled characteristic curves preserve digitized Kodak E-7022 (2016), shared Gold 200 curve retained by Kodacolor 100 density records with C1 interpolation. The first and last 12 points of each record provide monotonic extrapolation outside the published range. Runtime rendering data only. See licenses/FILM-PROFILES.txt. Edge inscriptions and approximate physical placement follow the manufacturer documents and developed-film photographs in edgePrinting.sources; see docs/print-frame-model.md. The DX edge barcode encodes the DX number cited in edgePrinting.dx.source.
